title: Evoker Totem
description: An evoker texture (16x) for the totem of undying.
body:
**This pack changes the totem of undying's texture to an evoker design totem (16x)**

<details>
<summary>📧 Credit (Original Author)</summary>

Art by **u/Foxiak14** on Reddit (posted in **r/Minecraft**)

</details>

![Evoker Totem Design](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6b287662ecab4b8acec035b5c915d3ec4512c45a.png)

## 🔩 Supports:
- 1.21.9+
- Incompatible with mods or resource packs that change the totem of undying's texture.

## 🎈 More Info:

<details>
<summary>🧰 Updates</summary>
We will update the pack as quickly as we can after a new Minecraft version comes out.
</details>

<details>
<summary>🎨 Altering, Customizing, and Uploading the Pack</summary>
You can change assets inside the pack, but you cannot upload it anywhere (Modrinth, Curseforge, Social Media, etc.). Use it for yourself and the people you know. If you want to create addons/extensions for my packs, please delete all the assets I made, then upload your own anywhere you'd like.
